sentences.en: I'm David Marchese.

sentences.en: It's not easy to have a clear perspective on a momentous life change, especially one that's just happened.

sentences.en: But in today's episode, that's exactly what I'll be asking Misty Copeland to try to do.

sentences.en: Because in this interview, Copeland is announcing her retirement from the American Ballet Theater

sentences.en: after a 25-year career there, putting a cap on a groundbreaking and remarkable trajectory.
sentences.zh: 结束她在那里25年的职业生涯，为其开创性和卓越的艺术轨迹画上句号。

sentences.en: She grew up in near poverty, her family often without a home of its own, and she didn't even start dancing seriously until she was 13, which is really late for a ballerina.
sentences.zh: 她在近乎贫困的环境中长大，家里经常居无定所，直到13岁她才开始真正认真地跳舞，这对于芭蕾舞演员来说已经很晚了。

sentences.en: But despite all that, she eventually joined the ABT in 2001, and after a 15-year climb, became the first Black woman ever to be named a principal dancer with the company.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，她最终还是在2001年加入了美国芭蕾舞剧院，并在经历15年的攀升后，成为了该剧院历史上第一位被任命为首席舞者的黑人女性。

sentences.en: She'll be dancing her farewell performance this fall.
sentences.zh: 她将在今年秋天上演告别演出。

sentences.en: Copeland, who's 42, is stepping away from the stage at a fraught time.
sentences.zh: 42岁的科普兰在局势紧张的时期退出了舞台。

sentences.en: The values of diversity and inclusion, which she embodies and works to promote, are under

sentences.en: So there's a lot for her to wrestle with right now, both personally and professionally, as she looks back on a legacy she's leaving behind and ahead to the rest of her life.
sentences.zh: 因此，当她回顾自己留下的遗产并展望未来的生活时，她现在有许多个人和职业上的事情需要去面对。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Misty Copeland.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与米斯蒂·科普兰的对话。

sentences.en: Misty, thank you for being here today.
sentences.zh: 米斯蒂，谢谢你今天来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: So you have been ramping down dancing for a while.
sentences.zh: 所以你已经逐渐减少跳舞有一段时间了。

sentences.en: I think it's been five years since you gave a performance at the ABT.
sentences.zh: 我想距离你在美国芭蕾舞剧院演出已经过去五年了。

sentences.en: So why does now feel like the time to make an official retirement announcement?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么现在感觉是宣布正式退休的时候了呢？

sentences.en: You know, I don't have a clear answer on that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我对此没有明确的答案。

sentences.en: It's, you know, this has been, in all honesty, I've wanted to just kind of fade away into the background, which is not really possible.
sentences.zh: 这，你知道，老实说，我一直想就这样悄悄淡出背景，但这其实是不可能的。

sentences.en: I think that the legacy of what I've created in terms of the way that I'm carrying so many stories of Black dancers who have come before me, like, I can't just disappear.
sentences.zh: 我认为我所创造的遗产的意义在于，我承载了那么多先于我的黑人舞者的故事，比如，我不能就这样消失。

sentences.en: I think there has to be an official closing to my time at American Ballet Theater, this company
sentences.zh: 我认为我与美国芭蕾舞剧院的这段时光必须有一个官方的结束，这家公司

sentences.en: that has meant everything to me and has given me the opportunities and the platform that I have.

sentences.en: And so, you know, it was in 2019 that I think I was processing that I think this is the end of this chapter.

sentences.en: And though I wasn't saying it out loud to the world, you know, I've already kind of moved on to that next place of what I want to be doing.

sentences.en: That answer really laid down a lot of useful track for me.

sentences.en: You know, thinking of so many young Black and Brown people that didn't even know that Lincoln Center was a place they could step foot in.
sentences.zh: 你知道，想到那么多甚至不知道林肯中心是他们可以涉足的之地的年轻黑人和棕色人种。

sentences.en: And when they see my poster on the front and they feel like, you know, and it opens their minds up to a whole new world.
sentences.zh: 当他们在正面看到我的海报，并且他们觉得，你知道，这为他们打开了一个全新世界的大门。

sentences.en: And to me, it's not just about coming to see me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这不仅是来看我。

sentences.en: It sparks their interests to want to participate and to want to learn more about the art form and whatever may take place at Lincoln Center as well.
sentences.zh: 它激发了他们想要参与并更多地了解艺术形式以及林肯中心可能发生的任何事情的兴趣。

sentences.en: But I think that it brings us together.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这把我们凝聚在了一起。

sentences.en: I think that art is the most incredible way to build bridges, no matter what political party you're in.
sentences.zh: 我认为艺术是建立桥梁的最不可思议的方式，无论你属于哪个政党。

sentences.en: Yeah, I can't think of a better way to show the power of representation than through my career.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想不出有什么比通过我的职业更能展示代表性的力量了。

sentences.en: And do you feel a sense of embattlement or at all discouraged from, you know, the fact that,
sentences.zh: 你是否感到四面楚歌，或者因为以下事实而感到气馁，

sentences.en: you know, things like institutions that explicitly say they are supporting DEI, like risk losing funding or, you know, federal funding for the arts in general seems under attack?
sentences.zh: 你知道，诸如明确表示支持DEI的机构面临失去资金的风险，或者艺术领域的联邦资金总体上似乎受到攻击？

sentences.en: I think that we're just kind of keeping our heads down and staying the course.
sentences.zh: 我想我们只是在埋头苦干，坚守阵地。

sentences.en: I don't think that it's about creating this big hoopla and public, but I think that continuing to be really intentional about the real work.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是为了制造大肆的喧嚣和公众关注，我认为这是关于继续对真正的工作保持真正的专注。

sentences.en: And I think that that's being done through Lincoln Center.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正通过林肯中心来完成。

sentences.en: I think there are a lot of other institutions that need to follow suit in terms of just, again, I think that it's reflected in the work that we're doing.
sentences.zh: 我认为还有许多其他机构需要效仿，再次，我认为这反映在我们正在做的工作中。

sentences.en: I don't think that there's any real shifts or changes that need to be made.
sentences.zh: 我不认为需要做出任何真正的转变或改变。

sentences.en: Just continue doing the work.
sentences.zh: 只需继续做这项工作。

sentences.en: It's all with the same mission in mind.
sentences.zh: 这一切都怀揣着相同的使命。

sentences.en: And again, I don't think we have to like scream it from the rooftops.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，我认为我们不必像在房顶上大喊大叫那样。

sentences.en: It's like you put talent in places that it should be and you will see diversity naturally or organically happen.
sentences.zh: 就像你把人才放在它应该在的地方，你就会看到多元化自然或有机地发生。

sentences.en: And I think it's fair to say that there's a certain type of historical or cultural nostalgia that suffuses ballet, certainly in the popular imagination.
sentences.zh: 我认为可以公平地说，某种历史或文化怀旧情绪充斥着芭蕾舞，当然是在大众想象中。

sentences.en: And that's why companies will program Swan Lake, Giselle or the Nutcracker over and over again, because those are the performances that will sell tickets.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么舞团会一遍又一遍地排演《天鹅湖》、《吉赛尔》或《胡桃夹子》，因为这些是能卖出票的演出。

sentences.en: How might the balance be adjusted so that ballet might start to look more different in the future than it currently does, even maybe at the cost in the short term of people
sentences.zh: 如何调整这种平衡，以便芭蕾舞在未来看起来与现在有所不同，哪怕短期内要付出人们

sentences.en: not buying quite as many tickets as they did?
sentences.zh: 买的票没有以前那么多的代价？

sentences.en: That's exactly where we need to start.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们需要开始的地方。

sentences.en: Solve that problem.
sentences.zh: 解决那个问题。

sentences.en: Done.
sentences.zh: 搞定。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that I think you have to take the leap and your audience is only as, you know, informed as you make them.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为你必须迈出这一步，你的观众的见识取决于你让他们了解多少。

sentences.en: And I think that if you just kind of keep perpetuating the same thing over and over again, that's all they're going to know.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果你只是不断地重复同一件事，那将是他们唯一知道的事情。

sentences.en: And then that becomes their taste.
sentences.zh: 然后那就成了他们的品味。

sentences.en: And like, well, that's what I want to see.
sentences.zh: 就像是，嗯，这就是我想看的。

sentences.en: But how do they even know if that's all they know, if that's all they see?
sentences.zh: 但如果那就是他们的全部所知，如果那就是他们眼中的全部，他们又怎么会知道呢？

sentences.en: And so I really think that it's about taking the leap.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，这真的需要勇敢迈出这一步。

sentences.en: And I know it's tough.
sentences.zh: 我也知道这很难。

sentences.en: I mean, we're not in a time where the arts are being supported.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们现在正处于一个艺术不受支持的时代。

sentences.en: And it's difficult financially for so many companies, especially in the States.
sentences.zh: 对许多公司来说，财政都很困难，尤其是在美国。

sentences.en: And so I think that it's a balance.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是一个平衡问题。

sentences.en: It's a balance of some risk and then leaning on the things that people will definitely come and see.
sentences.zh: 这是承担一些风险，同时依托于人们肯定会买票观看的内容之间的平衡。

sentences.en: And do you feel like the ABT has been taking risks in the way that you'd like them to see?
sentences.zh: 你觉得美国芭蕾舞剧院（ABT）在以你希望的方式承担风险吗？

sentences.en: And here I'm thinking of, you know, there was a couple of years ago, there was an op-ed by Gabe Stone
sentences.zh: 这里我想起，几年前，盖布·斯通（Gabe Stone）曾发表过一篇专栏文章

sentences.en: Share, I think is his name.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，他叫肖恩（Share）。

sentences.en: Do you know the op-ed I'm talking about?
sentences.zh: 你知道我说的那篇专栏文章吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Where he was a dancer at the ABT and said, yes, there were performers of color, but they were getting cast in comic roles or sinister.
sentences.zh: 他在文章中提到，作为ABT的舞者，虽然有有色人种表演者，但他们饰演的都是喜剧角色或反派角色。

sentences.en: Well, it wasn't exactly colorblind casting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这并不完全是盲目选角。

sentences.en: Was that your experience there?
sentences.zh: 你在那里也是这种经历吗？

sentences.en: Or do you feel like there's still kind of like a gap in that regard?
sentences.zh: 还是说你觉得在这方面仍然存在某种差距？

sentences.en: Um, yes, it was my experience a lot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，我深有体会。

sentences.en: Um, when I first joined being the, you know, earthy character, you know, I, I fought so hard to be given opportunity in classical works because often
sentences.zh: 嗯，我刚加入时，作为那种富有泥土气息的角色，我，我为了争取在古典作品中表演的机会进行了多么艰难的斗争，因为通常

sentences.en: the black and brown dancers were told that's not, you know, we're using you for the more contemporary, the more modern, more modern works.
sentences.zh: 黑人和棕色人种的舞者会被告知，这不是，你知道的，我们用你是为了更当代的、更现代的作品。

sentences.en: But, um, I definitely think that I've seen a big change at American Ballet Theater in particular in terms of the way that they view casting.
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，我绝对认为我看到了美国芭蕾舞剧院在选角观念上的巨大转变。

sentences.en: I've definitely been a voice in having these tough conversations.
sentences.zh: 我一直是进行这些艰难对话的发声者。

sentences.en: I mean, I remember being in my early twenties and going into the office and speaking to my artistic director and
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我记得我二十岁出头时，走进办公室和我的艺术总监交谈

sentences.en: being terrified and not knowing how to really articulate myself, but being really intentional about how I approached the conversations.
sentences.zh: 当时我很害怕，不知道该如何真正表达自己，但我对如何进行这些对话有着非常明确的意图。

sentences.en: Um, to ask for different roles, to ask for different roles and to really express, you know, that I feel like this is happening because of X, Y, and Z.
sentences.zh: 嗯，要求不同的角色，要求不同的角色，并真正表达，你知道的，我觉得发生这种情况是因为这样那样原因。

sentences.en: You know, I'm a black woman.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我是一个黑人女性。

sentences.en: I'm the only one here and I want to be given opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我是这里唯一的一个，我想获得机会。

sentences.en: And I think I'm not because I'm, I'm a black woman and to go in there and really be clear, um, and be
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我没有得到机会是因为我是，我是个黑人女性，去到那里并真正把话说清楚，嗯，并且

sentences.en: intentional, but also have grace, um, instead of going in there, like, you know, ready to, ready to fight.
sentences.zh: 抱有目的，但同时也要保持优雅，嗯，而不是一进去就好像，你知道的，随时准备着，准备好打架。

sentences.en: Um, though I think I was fighting in my own way.
sentences.zh: 不过我想我一直在用自己的方式抗争。

sentences.en: And so I think that there has been change made, but we still have a long way to go.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为已经发生了改变，但我们仍有很长的路要走。

sentences.en: I want to go back to your specific story.
sentences.zh: 我想回到你个人的故事上。

sentences.en: You know, you grew up in rough circumstances.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你是在艰苦的环境中长大的。

sentences.en: There was a lot of, you know, you sort of alluded to this earlier.
sentences.zh: 有很多，你知道的，你刚才也暗示过这一点。

sentences.en: There's a lot of instability in, in various ways.
sentences.zh: 在各个方面都有很多不稳定因素。

sentences.en: And then the lifeline for you was finding ballet, which in so many ways is like the exact opposite of, of instability.
sentences.zh: 对你而言，生命的救命稻草是发现了芭蕾，它在许多方面就像是不稳定因素的绝对反面。

sentences.en: You know, it's about, uh, discipline and rigor and repetition and structure.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它关乎，呃，纪律、严谨、重复和结构。

sentences.en: And I did wonder if as a young person in particular to kind of go from one extreme to the
sentences.zh: 我确实在想，作为一个年轻人，尤其是从一个极端走到另

sentences.en: other, um, where was the quiet time when like you just figured out who you are as a person?
sentences.zh: 一个极端，嗯，什么时候才有那种安静的时刻，让你能够弄清楚自己到底是一个什么样的人？

sentences.en: Do you know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, I, I truly think that ballet was this perfect missing piece in my life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我，我真的认为芭蕾是我生命中完美缺失的那块拼图。

sentences.en: You know, it helped me to develop.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它帮助我成长。

sentences.en: So I don't, it's almost like the antithesis of what most people experience when they're in dance, where I feel like a lot of people almost lose themselves in sense of identity
sentences.zh: 所以我不觉得，这几乎与大多数人在跳舞时的经历相反，我觉得很多人在身份认同感上几乎迷失了自我

sentences.en: and don't mature and are socially underdeveloped and all of these things.
sentences.zh: 而且没有成熟，在社交方面也不够成熟，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And I feel like the opposite thing happened for me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我身上发生了完全相反的事情。

sentences.en: I think that it, it opened me up and it, and it, um, it helped me to understand myself more.
sentences.zh: 我认为它，它让我敞开心扉，而且它，嗯，它帮助我更多地了解了自己。

sentences.en: And I was craving consistency.
sentences.zh: 我渴望规律。

sentences.en: I was craving discipline.
sentences.zh: 我渴望纪律。

sentences.en: I mean, I would go from day to day, night to night, not knowing where we were sleeping, not knowing if we were going to have food,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我日复一日，夜复一夜地生活，不知道我们要睡在哪里，不知道我们是否会有饭吃，

sentences.en: um, not knowing how I was going to get to school, if I was going to school.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不知道我该怎么去学校，甚至不知道自己能不能去上学。

sentences.en: So to be able to go into a studio every day at 3 PM and know I was going to do plies and tendus and degages and rond de champs,
sentences.zh: 所以每天下午3点能够走进练功房，知道自己要做擦地（plies）、小踢腿（tendus）、大踢腿（degages）和圆圈腿（rond de champs），

sentences.en: like as a child to know what's coming, that safety is so important.
sentences.zh: 作为一个孩子，知道接下来会发生什么，这种安全感是如此重要。

sentences.en: And I think that it helped, I feel like I grew and developed as a, as a person immensely in like the first three years of dance.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为它有帮助，我觉得在跳舞的前三年里，作为一个人，我在成长和发展上取得了巨大的进步。

sentences.en: I feel like it's ingrained in me now, like that structure and that discipline because of ballet, that it's helped me in, in how I approach everything in my life.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这种结构和纪律现在已经因为芭蕾而根植于我的骨子里，它帮助我处理生活中的一切事务。

sentences.en: There was something I was curious about in your memoir, which I think was published in 2014,
sentences.zh: 我有一件事一直很好奇，关于你的回忆录，我想那是2014年出版的，

sentences.en: kind of a long time ago now, but you know, in the memoir, you, you write a lot about growing up and about your relationship with your mom.
sentences.zh: 现在看来已经是很久以前了，但你知道，在回忆录中，你，你写了很多关于成长以及你和妈妈关系的内容。

sentences.en: And in there, just as there's like a passing phrase where you just say something to the effect of like, there are times you back then when you're
sentences.zh: 在那里，就像有一个顺便带过的短语，你只是说了一些大意是这样的内容：在那个时候，当你

sentences.en: writing, still struggle to understand your mom.
sentences.zh: 写作时，你仍然在挣扎着去理解你的母亲。

sentences.en: What were the things that you struggle to understand?
sentences.zh: 你以前努力想要理解的是什么？

sentences.en: And do you feel like 10 years later, you understand your mom more clearly?
sentences.zh: 你觉得10年后的今天，你对母亲有了更清晰的理解吗？

sentences.en: I think it was having, being able to see her point of view and her perspective.
sentences.zh: 我想这是因为能够看到她的观点和视角。

sentences.en: I mean, as a young girl and, you know, not, not always knowing why she made certain decisions.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，作为一个小女孩，而且，你知道的，并不，并不总是知道她为什么会做出某些决定。

sentences.en: Um, I think those were the things I didn't understand.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想这些就是我无法理解的事情。

sentences.en: Um, when, you know, through my, I don't know, eight year old eyes,
sentences.zh: 嗯，当，你知道，透过我，我不知道，八岁时的眼睛看时，

sentences.en: I'm like, but why do we have a home?
sentences.zh: 我会想，为什么我们没有一个家？

sentences.en: Why don't, why, you know, it was like, seemed so simple and clear.
sentences.zh: 为什么不，为什么，你知道，这看起来如此简单明了。

sentences.en: Um, and I think, you know, with age and as a wife and as a mom, I definitely have a different understanding of the choices that she made and why.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想，随着年龄的增长，作为一个妻子和一个母亲，我对她所做的选择以及原因绝对有了不同的理解。

sentences.en: And when you're thinking about six children and just being able to provide for them in some way, you know, as, as a single parent, you know, that was extremely difficult.
sentences.zh: 当你考虑到有六个孩子，作为单亲父母，只是为了能以某种方式养活他们，你知道，这极其困难。

sentences.en: I think that I have just more of an understanding that she never really got to grow up or, you know, have like a real childhood and became a mom, you know, at a young age.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我更能理解她其实从未真正长大，或者说，你知道，没有过真正的童年，就在很小的时候成了一位母亲。

sentences.en: And, and I think, um, you know, being adopted and being an only child and kind of wanting to create her own family, but not really being prepared to do so.
sentences.zh: 而且，我认为，嗯，你知道，被收养、作为独生子女，并且有点想要建立自己的家庭，却没有真正为此做好准备。

sentences.en: I think I just have a lot more empathy and understanding of why certain things happen the way they did.
sentences.zh: 我想我只是有了更多的同理心，并且理解了为什么有些事情会以那样的方式发生。

sentences.en: You know, in thinking about where you've come from and what you've achieved, the elements of that in a way are very legible and in some ways, like sort of easily digestible.
sentences.zh: 你知道，回想你的出身和你的成就，从某种程度上讲，这些经历非常清晰易懂，在某些方面，也算是一种容易消化的故事。

sentences.en: Like we can put your story in a clean box, you know, there's like a rags to riches element to it.
sentences.zh: 就像我们可以把你的故事放进一个干净的盒子里，你知道的，里面有一种“从赤贫到暴富”的元素。

sentences.en: And then also sort of like a, um, racial groundbreaking element to it.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一种，嗯，种族突破的元素。

sentences.en: But it makes me wonder also if there are aspects of where you've come from and, and what you've achieved that you think like, well, the way
sentences.zh: 但这让我也想知道，你的出身和所取得的成就中，是否有一些方面让你觉得，嗯，虽然大家

sentences.en: people understand me, I get it, but it's a little more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 理解我的方式我能理解，但事情其实要比那复杂得多。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是的。

sentences.en: Um, I think there's been a narrative that's kind of been created and, and, um, just kind of carried on throughout my career, which is why I think people are often
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为有一种叙事已经被创造出来，并且，嗯，一直延续到我的整个职业生涯中，这就是为什么我认为人们看到我时经常会

sentences.en: shocked when they see me and they're like, oh, you're very petite.
sentences.zh: 感到震惊，他们会说，哦，你非常娇小。

sentences.en: Like you look like a ballerina.
sentences.zh: 就像你看起来像个芭蕾舞演员一样。

sentences.en: And I think the narrative that's been created is really that, um, you know, I don't have the body.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为被创造出来的这种叙事其实是，嗯，你知道的，我没有那种体形。

sentences.en: I'm too big.
sentences.zh: 我太胖了。

sentences.en: I'm too this, but it's so complex.
sentences.zh: 我太这样了，但情况是如此复杂。

sentences.en: You know, at 13 years old, the reason that things happened so quickly for me was because I was so natural.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在13岁时，事情之所以对我很顺利，是因为我太有天赋了。

sentences.en: I had all the, you know, the right body proportions that they look for.
sentences.zh: 我拥有，你知道，他们所寻找的所有正确的身体比例。

sentences.en: I, you know, I had a small head and long legs and long arms and long feet and I was flexible and I was strong.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道，我有着小小的脑袋、修长的腿、修长的胳膊和修长的脚，而且我很柔软，我也很强壮。

sentences.en: And then I became a professional dancer and all of a sudden I no longer had the right body type.
sentences.zh: 然后我成为了一名职业舞者，突然之间，我不再拥有正确的体形了。

sentences.en: So, you know, I went from being a prodigy to all of a sudden being, you know, like you're wrong for dance and you're this.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我从一个神童突然变成了，你知道的，好像你不适合跳舞，你这也不行那也不行。

sentences.en: And it's kind of, it was like shocking to me, but it was like, this is just crazy that I could go from being this prodigy, this ideal

sentences.en: And I, you know, I don't fit into this idealized mold of what a ballerina is supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 而且我，你知道的，我并不符合人们对芭蕾舞演员应有形象的理想化塑造。

sentences.en: And so, my relationship with the company, with my artistic director, with the dancers in the company, completely has, you know, evolved through that time.
sentences.zh: 所以，我和舞团、我的艺术总监以及舞团里的舞者们的关系，在这个过程中确实完全演变了。

sentences.en: But it took a lot of patience.
sentences.zh: 但这需要极大的耐心。

sentences.en: Something that I was really thinking about was this sort of wave that's happening of attacks on DEI.
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考的一件事是当前这种针对多元、平等与包容（DEI）的攻击浪潮。

sentences.en: And the way you put it was, you want to put your head down and do the work.
sentences.zh: 而你的表达方式是，你想埋头苦干。

sentences.en: Like, you don't need to be out there shouting from the rooftops.
sentences.zh: 就像，你不需要站在房顶上大声疾呼。

sentences.en: I just wonder if you could sort of explain that approach a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道你是否能再多解释一下这种方法。

sentences.en: Because if there were a time to shout from the rooftops, like, it seems like this is one of those times when, you know, maybe there's a fear of backlash or reprisal.
sentences.zh: 因为如果有一个需要站在房顶上大声疾呼的时刻，这似乎就是其中之一，你知道的，也许大家对遭到强烈反对或报复心存恐惧。

sentences.en: So, like, why the inclination to put the head down and do the work, rather than shout from the rooftop?
sentences.zh: 所以，为什么倾向于埋头苦干，而不是在房顶上大喊大叫呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, I go with my instinct a lot.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我很大程度上遵循我的直觉。

sentences.en: And during the pandemic, George Floyd,
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间，乔治·弗洛伊德事件发生时，

sentences.en: it felt like the time to speak up and, you know, shine a light on the injustice that so many have felt for so long and give a really clear, like, you know, perspective and example.
sentences.zh: 感觉是时候大声说出来了，你知道的，去揭露许多人长期以来感受到的不公，并给出一个非常清晰的、你知道的视角和榜样。

sentences.en: And I think that we're in a place now where it's so muddy.
sentences.zh: 而我认为我们现在处于这样一个时期，一切都变得非常混浊。

sentences.en: And I think that, I mean, I don't want to say that, yes, like, you know, we're trying to stay away from backlash, but it's like,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，我的意思是，我并不是说，是的，就像，你知道的，我们试图远离强烈的反对，但这就好像是，

sentences.en: you lose focus on what the work really is when there's all this other outside noise around it,
sentences.zh: 当周围有所有这些其他的外部噪音时，你就会失去对真正工作的焦距，

sentences.en: rather than, like I said, you know, you're putting your head down and you're doing work.
sentences.zh: 而不是像我说的，你知道的，埋头苦干。

sentences.en: Like,
sentences.zh: 就像，

sentences.en: I'm in these communities and I'm having these conversations and I'm, you know, creating programs that will go beyond this, you know, this administration.
sentences.zh: 我在这些社区里，我正在进行这些对话，并且我在，你知道的，创建能够超越这个，你知道的，这个管理层的项目。

sentences.en: And that to me is what's important is that we keep consistent and doing the work in a way that, you know, is not going to,
sentences.zh: 对我来说重要的是，我们要保持一致，并以一种，你知道的，不会，

sentences.en: I guess, ruffle any feathers and have focus on us where there's, where there's funding taken away, where, you know, it's really complicated.
sentences.zh: 我想，惹恼任何人或者把焦点集中在我们身上从而导致资金被撤回的方式来继续工作，你知道的，这真的很复杂。

sentences.en: It is complicated.
sentences.zh: 这确实很复杂。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think that this is bigger than the language that, that we're using.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这比我们正在使用的语言要宏大得多。

sentences.en: This is not something that has just come about, you know, post George Floyd or because of this administration.
sentences.zh: 这不是那种乔治·弗洛伊德事件之后或者因为本届政府才刚刚出现的事情。

sentences.en: Like this is work that I've been doing since I started ballet.
sentences.zh: 就像这是我从开始跳芭蕾舞以来一直在做的工作。

sentences.en: Like it's, it's work that's undeniable when you are a minority, um, that, that, you know, it just is what it is and you're doing it.
sentences.zh: 就像当你是少数族裔时，这是不容否认的工作，嗯，你知道的，事情就是这样，而你正在做。

sentences.en: So again, this isn't something new, this isn't some trend that we're on.
sentences.zh: 所以再说一次，这不是什么新鲜事，这不是我们赶上的什么潮流。

sentences.en: Um, it's, it's real important work that's affecting real lives every day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是真正重要的工作，每天都在影响着真实的生活。

sentences.en: And when you're in communities talking with people and sort of educating about dance and are the kinds of conversations you're having with people
sentences.zh: 当你在社区里与人们交谈并普及舞蹈知识时，你最近与人们进行的对话，

sentences.en: different recently than they were 10 years ago, 15 years ago, like, are the concerns different?
sentences.zh: 和10年前、15年前有什么不同吗？比如，大家的关注点有什么不同吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Through our Be Bold program, through the Misty Copeland Foundation, we're in the Bronx and we're in Harlem.
sentences.zh: 通过我们的“勇敢”项目（Be Bold program），通过米斯蒂·科普兰基金会，我们来到了布朗克斯和哈林区。

sentences.en: And a lot of these people with this administration and post the pandemic pulled their children out of schools for fear of a lot of things, you know, um, not having citizenship or
sentences.zh: 在这次政府执政期间以及疫情之后，许多这样的人出于对很多事情的恐惧，把他们的孩子从学校接走了，你知道的，嗯，没有公民身份或者

sentences.en: whatever it is, you know, that they, a fear of ice, you know, but this is like the one community social outlet that they have.
sentences.zh: 无论是什么，你知道的，他们对移民和海关执法局（ICE）感到恐惧，你知道的，但这却是他们拥有的唯一的社区社交途径。

sentences.en: So I guess it is different in a way that like, we're having those real conversations.
sentences.zh: 所以我想它确实有所不同，在某种程度上，我们在进行那些真实的对话。

sentences.en: Like, am I safe to come in and take this class?
sentences.zh: 比如，我来上这节课安全吗？

sentences.en: But this is it.
sentences.zh: 但这就是全部。

sentences.en: This is all I have.
sentences.zh: 这就是我拥有的全部。

sentences.en: This is like a lifeline.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一条生命线。

sentences.en: And it's also a beautiful escape and it's healing.
sentences.zh: 它也是一种美妙的逃避，并且具有治愈作用。

sentences.en: And it's just so important and necessary, uh, for our society, for our communities.
sentences.zh: 对于我们的社会、我们的社区来说，它真的是如此重要和必要。

sentences.en: I'm also curious about how you see dance's place in the culture.
sentences.zh: 我也很好奇你是如何看待舞蹈在文化中的地位的。

sentences.en: Because, you know, I was thinking about how, you know, like the tens of millions of people love to see, you know, viral TikTok dances.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我在想，几千万人都喜欢看，你知道的，那些走红的TikTok舞蹈。

sentences.en: Who knows how many people every Friday and Saturday night are going out dancing, dancing all different styles all over the country.
sentences.zh: 谁知道每个周五和周六晚上有多少人在全国各地外出跳舞、跳着各种不同的风格。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you know, we don't really think of dance as an art form as kind of like venerated or central to the culture in the way that that music or film is.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，你知道，我们并没有真正将舞蹈视为一种像音乐或电影那样备受尊崇或处于文化核心的艺术形式。

sentences.en: Do you have any thoughts about why dance as an art form seems to occupy this odd space?
sentences.zh: 你对为什么舞蹈作为一种艺术形式似乎占据着这样一个奇怪的空间有什么看法吗？

sentences.en: It is so frustrating.
sentences.zh: 这太令人沮丧了。

sentences.en: You know, I'm constantly having these conversations, you know, with my producing partner, with my team, um, you know, through my production company, as we're, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我经常和我的制片合作伙伴、我的团队进行这些对话，你知道的，通过我的制作公司，当我们，你知道的，

sentences.en: constantly trying to prove that dance is such a integral part of every culture.
sentences.zh: 不断地试图证明舞蹈是每一种文化中不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: And that for some reason, it's not valued in the same way that, you know, music is or fashion is or food is.
sentences.zh: 并且不知为何，它并没有像，你知道的，音乐、时尚或美食那样受到同等程度的重视。

sentences.en: And it's so mind blowing because I mean, I could stand in a room and ask how many of you have, have danced in your life, everyone's going to raise their hand.
sentences.zh: 这太令人匪夷所思了，因为我的意思是，我可以站在一个房间里问有多少人在生活中跳过舞，每个人都会举手。

sentences.en: You know, it's a part of our culture.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是我们文化的一部分。

sentences.en: And for some reason, we we don't allow ourselves to like embody that concept and idea.
sentences.zh: 但不知为何，我们不允许自己去体悟那个概念和想法。

sentences.en: I mean, so I don't know that I have an answer for that or why we try to resiSt. To me, it's it's mind blowing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所以我不知道我是否有答案来解释这一点，或者为什么我们试图抗拒。对我来说，这简直匪夷所思。

sentences.en: And the fact that, you know, I sit on call after call and pitch after pitch, trying to prove to people that,
sentences.zh: 事实上，你知道的，我参加了一个又一个会议，做了无数次提案，试图向人们证明，

sentences.en: you know, everyone dances and wants to see dance, it just has to be done the right way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每个人都跳舞，也想看舞蹈，它只是需要以正确的方式完成。

sentences.en: And I think with an authentic voice behind it.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为其背后需要有真实的声音。

sentences.en: Did you happen to read Jennifer Homan's book, Apollo's Angels,
sentences.zh: 你碰巧读过詹妮弗·霍曼斯的书《阿波罗的天使：

sentences.en: The History of Ballet?
sentences.zh: 芭蕾舞史》吗？

sentences.en: I definitely read it, but I think I was very young when I read it.
sentences.zh: 我绝对读过，但我想我读的时候很年轻。

sentences.en: I think it came out like 2010.
sentences.zh: 我想它大概是2010年出版的。

sentences.en: So it's, you know, 15 years ago or something.
sentences.zh: 所以那是，你知道的，15年前左右的事情了。

sentences.en: But so it's this beautifully
sentences.zh: 但这是一部文笔优美、

sentences.en: written, assiduously researched history of ballet.
sentences.zh: 考证严谨的芭蕾舞史。

sentences.en: And at the end, and this is in 2010, when the book was published, you know, she basically says she thinks ballet is a dying art form.
sentences.zh: 在最后，也就是在2010年这本书出版时，你知道，她基本上说她认为芭蕾是一门正在消亡的艺术形式。

sentences.en: There's too much adherence to tradition.
sentences.zh: 对传统的坚持太多了。

sentences.en: It involves like a kind of idealism and self-control that the culture doesn't really value that much anymore, particularly in cynical times.
sentences.zh: 它涉及一种文化不再那么重视的理想主义和自我控制，尤其是在这个愤世嫉俗的时代。

sentences.en: And I don't know what she would say, but my hunch is that I don't think she would say that much has changed in the 15 years since that book came out.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她会怎么说，但我的直觉是，她不会认为自那本书出版以来的15年里发生了太大的变化。

sentences.en: What's your response to that argument?
sentences.zh: 你对这个观点有什么回应？

sentences.en: Yes, I very much remember this, exactly what you just said.
sentences.zh: 是的，我非常记得这件事，完全就是你刚才说的那样。

sentences.en: And one thing that I wholeheartedly believe in and stand behind is that the ballet technique is one of the most perfect and beautiful things I've ever experienced.
sentences.zh: 而我深信不疑并且坚定支持的一点是，芭蕾舞技巧是我所经历过的最完美、最美丽的事物之一。

sentences.en: And I don't think that's the issue.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为问题并不在于此。

sentences.en: And I don't think that that's something that people can't connect with.
sentences.zh: 而且我不认为这是人们无法产生共鸣的东西。

sentences.en: It hasn't needed to change in hundreds of years because it's just, I think, perfection.
sentences.zh: 它几百年来都不需要改变，因为我认为它简直就是完美。

sentences.en: And I'm experiencing it in real time, again, with these young kids that I'm teaching in communities that, like, there's no connection.
sentences.zh: 而我正在实时地重新体验这一点，通过我正在那些毫无联系的社区里教导的这些年轻孩子们。

sentences.en: They don't care about ballet.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不在乎芭蕾。

sentences.en: Their parents are like, what?
sentences.zh: 他们的父母则是一脸茫然：什么？

sentences.en: And showing them the value of the discipline, the value of the technique, and how it connects to so many things that they do in their lives.
sentences.zh: 向他们展示纪律的价值、技巧的价值，以及它如何与他们生活中所做的许多事情相联系。

sentences.en: And I think it has to be fed to us in the right way.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为它必须以正确的方式呈现给我们。

sentences.en: And I think that when it's exclusive, and you don't see people that represent a broad range of people, and you don't see the real complexity of what a dancer's experience
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，当它是排他的，当你看不到代表广泛人群的人，当你看不到舞者经历的真实复杂性

sentences.en: is, but this narrow view, you know, where, again, you're this skinny white girl, and you're being
sentences.zh: 而是这种狭隘的视野，你知道的，再次让你觉得你是一个骨瘦如柴的白人女孩，你正在遭受

sentences.en: tortured and abused, and you're having an affair with the choreographer, and, you know, all of these
sentences.zh: 折磨和虐待，你和编舞有染，你知道的，所有这些

sentences.en: tropes and stereotypes, it's like, if we keep that narrow view and we just keep perpetuating it, then no one's going to want to be a part of it.
sentences.zh: 老套路和刻板印象，这就好比，如果我们保持这种狭隘的视野并不断延续它，那么就不会有人想参与其中了。

sentences.en: So I truly believe that it's not a dying art form if we handle it with care moving forward.
sentences.zh: 所以我坚信，如果我们未来妥善处理，它绝不是一门正在消亡的艺术形式。

sentences.en: So when you go on stage for your last performance in the fall, what do you hope you'll feel in that
sentences.zh: 所以在秋天你的最后一场演出登台时，你希望在那一刻感受到什么，

sentences.en: moment that will make that performance be a satisfying ending to this part of your career and your life?
sentences.zh: 能让那场演出成为你职业生涯和人生这一阶段的一个令人满意的句号？

sentences.en: I hope that, you know, I don't even have hopes.
sentences.zh: 我希望，你知道的，我甚至没有什么期望。

sentences.en: I think that I don't have hopes and dreams and, you know, for what's going to happen that night.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我对那天会发生什么没有什么期望和梦想，你知道的。

sentences.en: I think that I'm going to, I'm going to go out there feeling in control of the decision that I've made to do it, the pieces that I'm choosing to
sentences.zh: 我觉得我会，我会带着对这些决定的掌控感走上舞台——我决定这么做，我选择去

sentences.en: dance, the shape that I'm going to be in, because it's like, I only have control over so much.
sentences.zh: 跳的舞段，我将要保持的状态，因为这就像是，我只能掌控这么多。

sentences.en: You know, what's so interesting is that after I saw you, you know, I had done the shoot in the
sentences.zh: 你知道，很有意思的是，在你见到我之后，你知道的，我早上拍了

sentences.en: morning, and it was the first time I've done a shoot without wearing pointe shoes, really.
sentences.zh: 写真，那真是我第一次在拍写真时没有穿硬鞋。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: I've done fashion shoots and things like that, but really like a movement shoot.
sentences.zh: 我拍过时尚大片之类的，但真的可以说是动作写真。

sentences.en: And I left thinking
sentences.zh: 我离开时想的是

sentences.en: that wasn't me.
sentences.zh: 那不是我。

sentences.en: You know, almost like feeling like a fraud, like I'm like in my bare feet.
sentences.zh: 你知道，几乎觉得自己像个骗子，就像我光着脚一样。

sentences.en: I'm like,
sentences.zh: 我想，

sentences.en: I'm used to being on pointe and just like really moving so freely in a way that I know.
sentences.zh: 我习惯了穿硬鞋，并且以我所熟知的方式真正自由地移动。

sentences.en: And after the shoot, I pulled my pointe shoes out, brought them into class.
sentences.zh: 拍完写真后，我把硬鞋拿出来，带到了课堂上。

sentences.en: I've been on pointe now for three classes, and I'm considering wearing pointe shoes for my final performance.
sentences.zh: 我现在的这三节课都穿了硬鞋，我正在考虑在最后的演出中穿硬鞋。

sentences.en: So I want to allow myself the freedom to do what feels right and feels good because I want to enjoy myself.
sentences.zh: 所以我想给自己自由去做那些感觉正确和感觉美好的事，因为我想享受这一切。
